logp.method_description: The log Po/w values of Pt-DHA and Pt-BisDHA were determined using the shake-flask method. n-octanol and PBS buffer were added into a beaker, and the two-phase mixture was stirred at 25 °C for 24 h to obtain PBS-saturated octanol and octanol-saturated PBS. Then, 4.0 mg Pt-DHA or Pt-BisDHA was dissolved in 2.0 mL PBS-saturated octanol. The solution was filtered using a 0.22-μm syringe filter, and a small fraction of filtrate was taken out to measure the Pt content (marked as C(total)) using ICP-MS. Next, 1.0 mL of the remaining filtrate was mixed with 1.0 mL of octanol-saturated PBS in a tube. The tube was shaken at 25 °C in darkness for 24 h. Finally, the two phases were separated by centrifugation (8000 rpm, 60 min), and the Pt content (marked as C(PBS)) in the PBS phase was determined by ICP-MS. All the experiments were carried out in triplicate. The log Po/w value was calculated using the equation below. log𝑃𝑜/𝑤=log[(𝐶(total)-𝐶(PBS))/𝐶(PBS)]
